description: Create a Vercel preview deployment. Direct production creation is disabled: production must use the canonical Safe Beta delivery rail with shared exact-SHA admission, staged smoke, promotion proof, and a terminal receipt. Pass deployment_id to redeploy an existing commit, or project_id + git_ref to deploy fresh from git. Set force_new=true to skip the build cache.

deployment_id.description: Redeploy the git source of this existing deployment.

git_ref.description: Branch or SHA to deploy. Defaults to 'main'.

project_id.description: Deploy fresh from the project's linked git repo.

target.description: Use 'preview'. 'production' is refused and must use the canonical delivery rail.

name: vercel_create_deployment
